Name: Multi-Screen Multiplayer (Coop Cursor)
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
[size=4]Replaces the hardware bound cursor for P1 with a virtual cursor, just like it works for P2-P4 in local Co-Op.
This is useful when running multiple game instances on a single device as all instances' P1 would otherwhise share the same cursor.
